metadata.description: V2 get single assignment by UUID (GET /devicesensors/assignments/{assignmentUuid}), 200. Captured after the update (op 8); name reflects the updated value under anonymization. NOTE: this endpoint's default output filename (devicesensors_get_assignments.json) collides with the plural list endpoint's filename in mock-capture -- a tool defect, not specific to this data; captured to a separate directory to avoid clobbering.
